title: Shinonome Ena — Brand New Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Front Entrance

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (There aren't any classes today because of the opening ceremony, but there's still more people here than I expected.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I guess they're all busy with club stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Sports Club Members
rows.Line: Louder! I still can't hear you!

rows.Speaker: Sports Club Members
rows.Line:
One more!
You can do it!

rows.Speaker: Sports Club Members
rows.Line: That's it! Now do it again!

rows.Speaker: Sports Club Members
rows.Line: Okay, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Whoa... I can hear them from over here...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Maybe they're all excited about being a year older now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Which makes sense. It's the beginning of a new year and a chance for a fresh start.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But it's like nothing's changed for us.
We're also having the opening ceremony in the gym, but it's gonna be so dull since there's never anyone there.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Honestly, it doesn't really feel like I've become a third-year.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But griping like this won't change anything. I should just head over...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hm? Isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, aren't these the new class rosters...? Did the teachers forget to take them down?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And they're tiny.
I'm guessing everyone had to crowd around these just to see which classes they were put in.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (That takes me back...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I remember crowding around these with friends to see where I was up through junior high.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hmm... Any luck, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Nope. How about you?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Nope. I can't see because of everyone's heads.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Ugh... Move out of the way if you've already found your name. I'll try standing on my tip toes and...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Maybe...!
Hey, I think I saw...

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Huh?! Owww!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Wait, huh? What happened?

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
My legs started cramping up.
*Sigh*
That was close...

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Wait, just from standing on your toes?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Haha! I get that you love to draw, Ena, but you really gotta exercise when you can.

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line:
Shut up.
You can't show me a little sympathy?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Based on that, I take it you're just fine now. Oh, there's our opening! Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: Hey, wait!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Just seeing which classes we were in was a huge pain, but it was also pretty exciting at the same time.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And it's always fun to see who your new classmates are. I remember talking on and on about being placed in the same class as certain people.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, actually...
I could try looking for Mizuki and the others.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's see... Class A should be...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm... Oh, here we go.
Akito Shinonome, and...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, they're in the same class?
That's an interesting combination.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I didn't see Toya's name in Class A.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. Sorry, Akito.
Looks like you and your partner don't get to be in the same class.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I guess that isn't too bad since they hang out together all the time...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, I'm curious to see which class he's in. I think his last name's Aoyagi...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, he's in Class B... That's right next door... Wait, Mizuki too?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Are they friends? I forget...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(And Shiraishi's in a different class.
That's a bit of a shame since Mizuki said they get along pretty well...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But Toya's really nice and considerate...
It's interesting how he can be a little absent-minded sometimes, so I'm sure they'll have fun together.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. I think I'll bring this up when I get home before we start working tonight.
